title: AuthProof
description: Decoded form of the `X-LS-Auth` request header (LSP-1 section 4.3.6; LSP/1.1 secure profile, Increment 3). On the wire the header value is the five dot-separated parts `v1.<cert>.<ts>.<nonce>.<sig>`; `$defs/header` pins that exact text form (at most 4 KiB), this document pins the decoded members. `cert` is the sender's DER certificate (at most 2 KiB = 2731 base64url characters), `ts` the sender's clock in Unix epoch milliseconds (accepted within +-120 s of the receiver's clock), `nonce` 16 random bytes (22 characters) remembered for replay detection, `sig` the raw 64-byte ECDSA P-256 signature r||s (86 characters) over the signed text of LSP-1 section 4.3.6 (domain `LSP1-AUTH-v1`, request method and target, SHA-256 of the body, ts, nonce, server fingerprint, client fingerprint). The sender's fingerprint is not carried: it is the uppercase hex SHA-256 of `cert`. Base64url is unpadded and canonical. The header is not JSON on the wire; this schema validates the object a parser produces from it.

v.description: Proof format version. Only `v1` exists; anything else is AUTH_INVALID.

cert.description: Sender's X.509 certificate, DER, base64url without padding; at most 2048 bytes.

ts.description: Sender clock, Unix epoch milliseconds. On the wire: decimal digits without leading zeros (it is signed as that exact text).

sig.description: ECDSA P-256 signature, raw r||s (64 bytes), base64url, exactly 86 characters.

header.description: The whole `X-LS-Auth` header value: `v1.<cert>.<ts>.<nonce>.<sig>`. Base64url never contains `.`, so the five parts split unambiguously. At most 4096 bytes.
